blocks.text: Kim Chiu, who is in the middle of a legal battle with her sister Lakam Chiu, has embraced her “girl boss energy” and remained optimistic amid an “unexpected plot twist” in her business. While she has yet to publicly speak about her falling-out with her older sister, the actress-TV host seemed to have alluded to the matter through her Instagram post shared on Tuesday, Sept. 15. In her post, Kim announced the latest offering of her bag business which she previously managed alongside Lakam. “Started a business in 2023, faced an unexpected plot twist.
